name: Hayama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hayama town emblem in green and black: a wreath of green leaves with a black base enclosing a white stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Hayama, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 1984.

features.role: Hayama town emblem — a wreath of green leaves with a black base enclosing a white stylised device
